title: C inference on the hub: 16x over Q12, swing-up net now fits the budget
question: What does pybricks.experimental.MLP (C forward pass, custom firmware) actually cost per call on the Technic Hub, and does a trotter-scale net fit in 64K RAM?
headline: 4-8-8-1 runs at 100 us/call vs 1607 us for the fully unrolled Q12 MicroPython (16x, 2% of the 2 ms loop budget). 4-32-32-1 -- the swing-up net that was 9x OVER budget in MicroPython -- now runs at 365 us (18% of budget). 30-64-64-12 MemoryErrors at construction (6924 float32 params + program on the 64K hub), settling it empirically: trotter-scale needs a SPIKE-class hub. The ~100 us floor is call machinery (arg conversion, boxing, dispatch), not math: 28x more MACs only tripled the time.
